rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when someone rides in a boat as a passenger.

example.english: We sail to Cheung Chau, so we don't need to drive.
example.traditional: 我哋去長洲嗰陣坐船，唔使自己揸車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 coeng4 zau1 go2 zan6 co5 syun4 m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 zaa1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when a boat or ship sets off and begins its voyage.

example.english: The ferry will sail at eight in the morning, and late passengers will have to wait for the next one.
example.traditional: 班船朝早八點開船，遲到就要等下一班。
example.jyutping: baan1 syun4 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 hoi1 syun4 ci4 dou3 zau6 jiu3 dang2 haa6 jat1 baan1

rows.note: Use this for the specifically nautical action of sailing or moving a boat by its sails, rather than merely riding in or departing by boat.

example.english: The wind is good today, so we sail the sailboat out to sea.
example.traditional: 今日風勢好，我哋𢃇隻帆船出海。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 fung1 sai3 hou2 ngo5 dei6 lei5 zek3 faan4 syun4 ceot1 hoi2
